A frontier LLM reads a small model’s weights, edits them in a sandbox, and tests each change, with no gradients and about $5 to $10 per run. items.title: A Yacht Was Found Drifting Off Australia With Its Radio Working and Nobody Aboard, and Nearly 20 Years Later No One Knows Where the Crew Went
items.excerpt: In April 2007, three men set sail on what should have been a routine voyage. Days later, their yacht was found drifting far out at sea. Everything seemed to be in order, yet no one was on board. Investigators were left with one small detail that might explain it all, and a family left asking whether it really does.
